ops.en: to attack someone violently, criticize them forcefully, or overwhelm them with persistent questions, doubts, smells, problems, or other pressures
ops.cn: 猛攻；猛烈抨击；（问题、疑虑、气味等）不断侵扰、袭来

ops.en: a collection or group of people or things brought together
ops.cn: 集合；聚集在一起的一群人或一批事物

ops.en: of various kinds or types; mixed
ops.cn: 各种各样的；混合的

ops.en: to make an unpleasant feeling, pain, fear, hunger, concern, or other discomfort less intense
ops.cn: 缓和、减轻（痛苦、恐惧、饥饿、忧虑等）

ops.meaning_cn: 缓解恐惧、焦虑、内疚或饥饿

ops.en: to surprise or amaze someone greatly
ops.cn: 使震惊；使大为惊讶

ops.en: protection or refuge granted by a state, especially to someone fleeing persecution or danger; political asylum
ops.cn: 庇护；尤指国家给予受迫害或面临危险者的政治庇护

ops.note: General shelter or refuge is the broader organizing idea.
Mental asylum is a historical/dated expression, not a neutral modern clinical label.

ops.en: boldly daring, sometimes to a shocking, rude, or convention-defying degree
ops.cn: 大胆的；敢作敢为的；有时大胆到令人震惊或冒犯

ops.en: a person who independently examines accounts, records, systems, controls, or compliance
ops.cn: 审计人员；检查账目、记录、系统、控制或合规情况的人

ops.note: Also a student who attends a course without taking it for credit.

ops.en: a distinctive atmosphere, feeling, or quality that seems to surround a person, place, or thing
ops.cn: 气氛；气质；仿佛环绕某人、某地或某物的独特感觉

ops.note: Medical aura: a sensory warning that can precede migraine or seizure.

ops.en: support, sponsorship, approval, guidance, or authority provided by a person or organization
ops.cn: 支持、赞助、认可、指导或权威

ops.meaning_cn: 在……的支持、赞助或主持下

ops.en: strict simplicity, self-denial, or avoidance of unnecessary comfort and luxury
ops.cn: 节制；简朴；严格克制享乐

ops.en: a policy of reducing public spending or consumption, especially to control debt or budget deficits
ops.cn: 经济紧缩政策；尤指为控制债务或赤字而削减公共支出

boundaries.note: Authorize is the common American spelling.
Authorise is the common British spelling of the same verb.

ops.en: a ruler or other person who holds and exercises absolute or largely unchecked power
ops.cn: 独裁者；掌握并行使绝对或几乎不受制约权力的人

ops.en: independent, self-governing, or self-operating without external control
ops.cn: 自主的；自治的；可独立运作而不受外部控制的

ops.en: able to operate or function independently without direct external control
ops.cn: 能自主运行的；无需直接外部控制即可工作的

ops.en: extreme greed for money, wealth, or possessions
ops.cn: 贪婪；对金钱、财富或财物的极端欲望

ops.en: strongly unwilling or opposed to something
ops.cn: 反对的；不愿意的；厌恶的

ops.meaning_cn: 反对、不愿或厌恶某事/做某事

ops.en: a strong dislike of, opposition to, or reluctance toward something
ops.cn: 厌恶；反感；强烈不愿

ops.meaning_cn: 对某事/做某事的厌恶或强烈不愿

ops.note: Literal turning-away sense is uncommon and secondary.

ops.en: formal or literary: to assert, affirm, or acknowledge something openly and confidently
ops.cn: （正式/文学）断言；明确承认或保证

ops.en: to speak maliciously or unfairly about someone who is absent
ops.cn: 背后说坏话；背后恶意中伤

ops.en: to repeatedly pester, pressure, or urge someone until they act or respond
ops.cn: 不断纠缠、催促或施压

ops.meaning_cn: 不断纠缠/施压使某人做某事

ops.en: to hesitate, refuse, or stop short when faced with a demand, difficulty, or risk
ops.cn: 犹豫；拒绝；遇到要求、困难或风险时退缩

ops.en: an obstacle or hindrance that prevents progress
ops.cn: 障碍；阻碍

ops.en: mild, pleasantly warm, and comfortable, especially of weather or air
ops.cn: 温和宜人的；尤指天气或空气温暖舒适的

ops.en: informal and dated: slightly crazy or eccentric
ops.cn: （非正式、旧式）有点疯狂或古怪的

ops.en: to make an unwanted thought, fear, doubt, or feeling go away
ops.cn: 消除、驱散（恐惧、疑虑、念头等）

ops.en: the exchange of goods or services directly for other goods or services without using money
ops.cn: 以物易物；不用货币直接交换商品或服务

ops.en: shy and self-conscious, especially in social situations
ops.cn: 害羞的；腼腆的；不自在的

ops.en: to relax and enjoy pleasant warmth or sunshine
ops.cn: 晒太阳；享受温暖

ops.meaning_cn: 沉浸、陶醉于（赞誉、荣耀、关注等）
ops.definition_en: to enjoy a pleasant situation such as praise, glory, or attention

ops.meaning_cn: 屏息地；紧张或期待地等待
ops.definition_en: while waiting anxiously or excitedly for what will happen

boundaries.condition: in the fixed phrase with bated breath
boundaries.note: Bated is historically/formally tied to bate = restrain or lessen; it is not a new Word owner.

ops.en: to hit or strike someone or something repeatedly and forcefully
ops.cn: 连续猛击；反复重击

ops.en: attractive, flattering, or suitable for a particular person or situation
ops.cn: 合适的；相称的；衬人的

ops.note: Formal propriety: appropriate according to custom or social expectations.

ops.en: to resent giving or allowing something, or to feel resentful envy toward someone for having it
ops.cn: 不情愿给；嫉妒、眼红某人拥有某物

ops.meaning_cn: 嫉妒/不情愿让某人拥有某物

ops.en: to give a false impression of something or fail to show its true nature
ops.cn: 掩饰真相；给人以错误印象

ops.en: to contradict or show that a statement, expectation, or appearance is false
ops.cn: 与……矛盾；证明……不真实

ops.en: hostile, aggressive, and ready to argue or fight
ops.cn: 好斗的；敌对的；挑衅的

ops.note: Formal international-law sense: engaged in war or belonging to a warring party.

ops.en: to shout or roar in a very loud, deep voice or sound
ops.cn: 吼叫；咆哮；大声喊

ops.en: a very loud, deep shout or roar
ops.cn: 吼叫声；咆哮声

ops.en: a natural inclination, tendency, or talent for a particular activity or way of thinking
ops.cn: 倾向；爱好；天赋

ops.note: Specialist grass sense is lower priority.

ops.en: to cause someone to lose a close relative or loved one through death
ops.cn: 使丧失亲人；使丧亲

ops.meaning_cn: 因死亡而失去某位亲人
